title: Schedule appointment successfully for Banho & Tosa service
description: Verify that a customer can schedule an appointment for the Banho & Tosa service within operational hours and capacity limits with valid pet details and payment.

steps.description: Navigate to the appointment scheduling page
Select service type as Banho & Tosa
Choose a date and time within allowed hours (e.g., 10:00 AM)
Enter valid pet details including weight within acceptable range
Select any optional extra services
Confirm the appointment
Appointment is successfully created, confirmation is shown, and the slot capacity is respected

title: Prevent scheduling beyond maximum capacity per time slot
description: Verify that scheduling more than two appointments for the same time slot is prevented according to business validation.

steps.description: Schedule two appointments for the same service and time slot
Attempt to schedule a third appointment for that same time slot
System rejects the third appointment attempt and displays an error about capacity limits

title: Validate scheduling time restrictions
description: Verify the system allows appointments only during operational hours: 9am-11am and 1pm-5pm.

steps.description: Try to schedule an appointment before 9:00 AM
Scheduling is denied with an appropriate error message
Try to schedule an appointment between 11:00 AM and 1:00 PM
Scheduling is denied with an appropriate error message
Try to schedule an appointment exactly at 9:00 AM and at 5:00 PM
Scheduling is allowed for these boundary times

title: Pricing calculation based on pet weight and extra services
description: Verify that pricing adjusts correctly according to the pet weight and any optional services selected during scheduling.

steps.description: Select a pet weight category and base service
Add various extra services
Displayed pricing reflects correct calculation based on weight and selected extras

title: Input validation for Brazilian formats
description: Ensure that date, phone number, and currency inputs conform to Brazilian formatting both on frontend and backend.

steps.description: Enter a date in incorrect format (non-Brazilian)
Input is rejected with validation error on frontend
Enter phone number with invalid digits or formatting
Input is rejected with validation error
Enter currency values with incorrect decimal or thousand separators
Input is rejected or corrected to Brazilian format

title: Authentication with Supabase and role-based access control
description: Verify that the system authenticates users through Supabase and enforces access restrictions based on user roles (customer, administrator, staff).

steps.description: Attempt login with valid credentials as customer
Login is successful, customer dashboard is accessible, and admin areas are restricted
Attempt login with valid credentials as administrator
Admin panel and management features are accessible
Attempt to access protected routes without login
Access is denied and user is redirected to login screen

title: Support offline operation via PWA capabilities
description: Verify that the app supports offline usage through the PWA setup including service worker caching and manifests, ensuring appointment scheduling page loads without internet.

steps.description: Load the app once with internet connectivity
Disconnect internet connectivity
Navigate to scheduling pages and try scheduling an appointment offline
App loads and allows limited offline functionality without crashing

title: Manage recurring monthly client subscriptions
description: Validate creation, scheduling, and payment tracking of monthly recurring clients with various recurrence types and discounts.

steps.description: Create a new monthly subscription client with selected recurrence (e.g., monthly)
Verify automatic future appointment scheduling
System correctly schedules recurring appointments and applies any eligible discounts
Update payment status for a recurring client
Payment tracking updates correctly and reflected in management dashboard

title: Daycare service enrollment capturing pet and owner behavior info
description: Verify that daycare service enrollment captures all required pet and owner behavior information accurately.

steps.description: Navigate to daycare enrollment form
Enter pet details along with behavior and owner information
Form accepts and saves all information correctly
Try submitting incomplete or invalid behavior info
Validation errors appear preventing submission

title: Pet hotel service managing check-in/out with additional services and authorizations
description: Verify the pet hotel service workflow including check-in, check-out, selection of additional services, and capturing digital authorizations.

steps.description: Simulate pet check-in process with necessary information
Select additional add-on services during stay
Capture digital authorization signature
Process pet check-out
All data is recorded correctly and displayed in management dashboard

title: Administrative panel dashboard displays accurate summarized data
description: Verify that the admin panel dashboards correctly display appointment counts, daily schedules, subscription statuses, and financial reports.

steps.description: Login as administrator
Navigate to the dashboard page
Verify dashboard data accuracy matches underlying database state including appointments, subscriptions, and revenue

title: Prevent scheduling conflicts for pet and time slot
description: Ensure the system prevents scheduling conflicts that would cause the same pet to be double booked or exceed capacity constraints.

steps.description: Schedule an appointment for a pet at a specific time slot
Attempt to schedule the same pet for another appointment overlapping the same time slot
System rejects conflicting appointment and informs the user

title: Mobile pet services scheduling with address validation
description: Verify the scheduling flow for Pet Móvel services includes condominium address capture and validation.

steps.description: Select Pet Móvel service in the scheduling app
Enter condominium address details including validated format
Address is verified and accepted if valid; rejected if invalid
Complete the appointment scheduling
Appointment is created successfully with the mobile service and address details

title: Responsive design check on mobile and desktop devices
description: Verify the application UI renders correctly and modals function properly on various screen sizes and device types.

steps.description: Open the app on a desktop browser and navigate through scheduling modals
All UI elements are correctly displayed and interactive
Open the app on multiple mobile devices and orientations
UI scales correctly; modals are accessible and usable without layout issues

title: Session management and logout handling
description: Validate that user sessions are maintained securely and users can logout effectively, clearing session data.

steps.description: Login as any user role
Perform several navigation and scheduling actions
Logout from the application
Session is terminated; protected pages redirect to login; no residual data accessible
